archive.noneTipSub: Set an archive category under Channels → Archive, then the channel can be archived here as well.
archive.none: Channel stays — no archive category set
archive.label: Archive the channel
archive.tipCancel: The channel moves into the archive category and nobody can write in it anymore. Nothing is deleted.
archive.tipDelete: The channel moves into the archive category and nobody can write in it anymore. It is never deleted.

cancel.title: Cancel event
cancel.reasonPlaceholder: Not enough healers, we are moving to Thursday.
cancel.notifyTip: Everyone who has not signed off gets the reason as a direct message from the bot.

delete.title: Delete event
delete.staysTipSub: Logs and loot carry the raid's name themselves and stay under History & Loot. The channel is never deleted.
delete.startedLabel: The raid has already taken place — delete anyway
delete.startedTip: Together with the signups, this raid's attendance disappears from the roster and the loot council.
delete.notifyTip: Off: nobody learns about it — right for test and mistaken events. On: everyone who has not signed off gets a short DM.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing changed yet — creation and signups are not part of the history.

move.title: Move
move.deadlineSub: moves along, same distance to the start
move.renameTip: #{current} → #{next}. Only the date and weekday in the name are replaced.
move.notifyTip: A post in the event channel that mentions everyone signed up. Those who signed off are not mentioned.

raider.title: Add raider
raider.removeText: The signup is removed. The raider gets no message.
raider.hintNewChar: The new character is also added to the raider's profile.
raider.hintDefault: Signup deadline and closed signups do not apply to the organisers.
raider.name: Name

invite.title: Call invites
invite.whoSub: Every raider in groups 1–5 of the approved setup, except you. Groups 6–8 and the bench wait.
